title: Repair with successful traces from the learner's own grasp basin
hypothesis: Successful traces from the learner's own grasp distribution produce more transferable symbolic repairs than saturated PPO demonstrations from a different grasp basin.

prediction.rationale: Baseline is an equal-budget expert-trace repair arm; compare final-incumbent sustained success on fresh development cases, paired over eight generation blocks, to test whether demonstration source resolves the documented takeover mismatch.

protocol.command: gpu run 'source ~/.profile >/dev/null 2>&1; nohup .venv-metaworld/bin/python -u scripts/run_full_evolution.py --config config/pen_spin_plateau_repair.yaml --study self_trace_source --block-seeds 4500,4501,4502,4503,4504,4505,4506,4507 --output-dir logs/pen_spin_self_trace_source > logs/r054.log 2>&1 &'
code_changes: Add self_success_trace_source to the existing script and config, using the frozen R-051 learner as the common parent.

Read archived successful learner trajectories without rerunning their spent seeds; compare 32 uniformly selected learner-success keyframes against 32 uniformly selected qualified-expert keyframes, with equal numbers of source episodes and identical field schemas.
Hold parent code, failure evidence, prompt instructions, editing freedom and candidate budget fixed; change only successful-demonstration source.

Run an ungated evidence-source component test, not a claimed plateau-trigger benefit: eight independent blocks, four repair candidates per arm, ten screening cases, promotion cases 10-39, and forty disjoint fresh development cases.
Budget per block: ten parent-screen episodes, eighty candidate-screen episodes, ninety promotion episodes including the shared parent, and eighty final-incumbent fresh episodes.
Use bc_steps=0 and gpt-6.1-sol with reasoning_effort high and temperature 1; allow at most one linked correction per slot, giving 64 primary calls and at most 64 corrections.

Require strictly positive promotion differences with paired t lower bounds above zero; retain the parent on ties or failed promotion. Analyse final outcomes with blocks, not individual cases, as the independent units.
Freeze and ledger-check manifest RNG streams before execution, keeping donor episodes disjoint from all new manifests.
This differs from R-042's expert-keyframe selection and R-052's expert learner-state corrections: it tests successful within-learner evidence without collecting PPO takeover labels.

falsified_by: An upper paired interval bound below +0.15 refutes the predicted improvement; an interval including zero cannot establish a benefit. If archived learner successes cannot supply the predeclared evidence budget without using evaluation cases, do not run the comparison.

approval.note: This directly tests demonstration-source mismatch without repeating expert-keyframe selection or claiming a plateau-trigger benefit. secondary_post_hoc.note: not predeclared as primary; candidate screens are 10 cases, 4 candidates per arm per block

controls.parent: frozen R-051 learner (config/pen_spin/r046_block3_incumbent), shared by both arms; fresh score shared when no promotion
controls.promotion_rule: strict paired difference > 0 and t lower bound > 0 vs the parent on cases 10-39

accounting.isaac_episodes_note: arm screens + promotions 560 per arm; parent screen 10 + promotion 30 + fresh 40 per block (fresh shared because neither arm promoted)

result.notes: Primary self minus expert fresh-incumbent success is 0.000 [0,0] over 8 blocks: no candidate in either arm promoted over the frozen parent (parent fresh mean 0.225), so both arms kept the parent everywhere. Secondary, not predeclared: self-trace candidates kept some of the parent behaviour (27/320 candidate screen successes, 3 candidates beat the parent screen, best challenger promotion 0.233 vs parent 0.333) while expert-trace candidates scored 0/320 and dropped the pen in 200/320 screen episodes (self 97/320, parent 14/80). Expert evidence drives edits that break the learner grasp; learner-success evidence does not break it but did not improve on it either.

verdicts.reasoning: Predicted self minus expert final-incumbent fresh success of at least +0.15, paired over eight blocks. Observed 0.000 with a degenerate [0, 0] interval (8 ties): no candidate in either arm passed the strict promotion rule against the frozen parent, so both arms kept the parent (fresh mean 0.225) in every block. The interval's upper bound is below +0.15, which refutes the prediction under this protocol (4 candidates per arm per block, one linked correction). Secondary and not predeclared: self-trace candidates kept some parent behaviour (27/320 candidate screen successes, 3 candidates beat the parent screen, block-level mean candidate screen self minus expert +0.084 [-0.008, +0.177], 7 wins 0 losses 1 tie) while expert-trace candidates scored 0/320 and dropped the pen in 200/320 screen episodes versus 97/320 for self and 14/80 for the parent. So the evidence source changes how much an edit damages the grasp, but neither source produced an improvement over the parent; the claim that self traces give more transferable repairs is not established at the final-incumbent level.

The named baseline—equal-budget expert-trace repair—was measured [logs/pen_spin_self_trace_source/summary.json]. The primary paired_success_difference was 0.000 with a 95% interval of [0.000, 0.000] across eight blocks; its upper bound is below the predicted +0.15, satisfying the predeclared refutation criterion [logs/pen_spin_self_trace_source/summary.json]. Neither arm promoted any candidate, so both retained the shared parent with mean fresh success 0.225; this tie is not an improvement [logs/pen_spin_self_trace_source/summary.json]. The post hoc candidate-screen difference was +0.084375 with interval [-0.008383, +0.177133], which includes zero and therefore does not establish a demonstration-source benefit or rescue the primary prediction [logs/pen_spin_self_trace_source/summary.json].

history.note: Before any LLM call or episode: (1) the study needs OpenAI calls, which only the orchestrator venv has (Isaac's Python lacks openai), so it runs through scripts/run_full_evolution.py --study self_trace_source (as R-049), not run_shadowhand_spin_stages.py; (2) one 80-case manifest per block (pen-spin manifests take one pool seed), seeds 4500-4507 recorded in the ledger, roles by index (screen 0-9, promotion 10-39, fresh 40-79); (3) evidence frozen and committed in config/pen_spin/r054_evidence/: self = first two sustained successes of the archived R-051 donor (recovery-0003, recovery-0006), expert = the two traced R-046 block-1 expert episodes (gait-0062, gait-0063), 16 uniform keyframes each, 32 rows per arm, identical fields and rounding; (4) the parent's fresh score is shared when both arms keep it, so episodes are at most 2080.

direction: Continue researching the single-step exploration pipeline with plateau-triggered trace repair, extended to pen spinning on the Shadow Hand (Isaac Lab Isaac-ShadowHandSpin-Stage{1,2,3}-Direct-v0, vendored in lares/envs/isaac_pen_spin; 157-d full obs, 20-d action, 60 Hz, 360-step episodes). Expert demonstrations: first try a hand-written scripted spinning controller; also search online for an existing trained pen-spinning policy; if neither qualifies, train an RL expert (rsl_rl PPO on the box). No budget ceiling on GPU hours or LLM calls. Known gaps to turn into questions: the env's spin_rate is roll about the pen's own long axis (not end-over-end twirl), success is per step with no episode rule, and the pipeline (manifests, obs schema, runner, records) is MetaWorld-only today. Debug issues, improve the pipeline, and turn unexpected findings into concrete research questions; document results and limitations.

advisor.reasoning: This directly tests demonstration-source mismatch without repeating expert-keyframe selection or claiming a plateau-trigger benefit. Archived donor adequacy is its weakest point, but the predeclared no-run gate addresses that risk, and block-level analysis avoids treating evaluation cases as independent search replicates. Approve 2080 episodes and at most 128 LLM calls using scripts/run_shadowhand_spin_stages.py and config/pen_spin_plateau_repair.yaml. Falsified_by: the predicted paired_success_difference increase of at least 0.15 against equal-budget expert-trace repair is refuted by an upper paired interval bound below +0.15; an interval including zero establishes no benefit.

implementer.reasoning: Agree; the 7 archived R-051 donor successes are the learner-success source (seed 4310 already spent, read only), and the expert keyframes come from the frozen R-046 demonstration trace.
